data.description: Dubai’s First Karl Lagerfeld-Branded Villas – Live Iconic

data.answer: Karl Lagerfeld Villas Dubai will be a distinguished addition to District 11, MBR City, seamlessly combining luxury living with an exclusive lifestyle. The master plan will showcase an impressive entrance, a picturesque pathway named The Catwalk, and a sophisticated Clubhouse Pavilion, offering residents a refined and immersive living experience.

Karl Lagerfeld Villas Dubai is set to epitomize luxury living, drawing inspiration from the brand's minimalist aesthetic to showcase sleek and sophisticated design principles. This exclusive collection will comprise 51 residences, thoughtfully categorized into four distinct types: 5-bedroom, 6-bedroom, 7-bedroom, and 7-bedroom premium villas. Each villa will span three floors, with the premium 7-bedroom villas uniquely featuring an additional basement level. The plot sizes and average covered areas are as follows:​
 

Notable features of these branded villas will include 'The Catwalk' walkway, a spiral staircase, sunken lounge, majlis, Karl's den and lounge, private swimming pool, gymnasium, entertainment deck, bar, and sky lounge. Additional amenities will encompass multiple powder rooms, laundry rooms, linen rooms, pantries, storage areas, and dedicated accommodations for maids and drivers. Each unit will also offer a spacious parking area, with the premium 7-bedroom villas providing the added convenience of basement parking.

Renting a Property in Karl Lagerfeld Villas

As of now, rental options are not available in Karl Lagerfeld MBR City, as the development is currently under construction with completion anticipated in Q2 2027. Prospective tenants are advised to monitor the project's progress for future leasing opportunities.

Buying a Property in Karl Lagerfeld Villas

For those interested in purchasing a property in this esteemed development, starting prices are as follows:​

  • 5-Bedroom Villas: Prices start at AED 15,000,000
  • ​6-Bedroom Villas: Prices start at AED 19,000,000
  • 7-Bedroom Villas: Prices start at AED 24,000,000

These prices may vary based on specific unit features and market conditions. Investing in Karl Lagerfeld real estate Dubai offers a unique opportunity to own a residence that embodies unparalleled luxury and sophisticated design.​

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Karl Lagerfeld Villas, MBR City?

data.answer:
Life in Karl Lagerfeld Villas, MBR City will offer an exclusive blend of refined elegance and privacy, set within a meticulously designed gated community. Future residents will experience a world of sophistication, with designer-inspired interiors, high-end amenities, and a serene yet connected lifestyle.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Karl Lagerfeld Villas

Residents of Karl Lagerfeld Villas, MBR City will benefit from convenient access to key road networks, ensuring smooth connectivity to the rest of Dubai. While the sub-community is still developing, the nearest public transportation options currently include bus and metro services operating in the surrounding areas. 

Bus routes 84, 15, and 21A serve neighboring districts, offering accessibility to those commuting via public transport. Additionally, Business Bay Metro Station and ONPASSIVE Metro Station are approximately 10 minutes away, providing further transit options.

Looking ahead, the completion of Etihad Rail is expected to enhance connectivity, offering seamless travel across the Emirates.

For those who drive, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), Al Khail Road (E44), and Al Meydan Road (D69) will provide efficient access to and from the community. Each villa within Karl Lagerfeld Villas will feature spacious private parking, with premium 7-bedroom villas offering the added convenience of basement parking, ensuring ample space for residents and their guests.

Shopping Mall Near Karl Lagerfeld Villas Dubai

MBR City is set to introduce Meydan One Mall, a world-class retail and entertainment destination that will be one of the largest shopping malls globally. Anticipated to open soon, this expansive mall will house over 600 retail stores featuring top luxury brands, along with more than 100 dining outlets. 
Designed to be a premier lifestyle hub, it will boast exceptional attractions, including the world’s largest dancing fountain, state-of-the-art indoor sports facilities with water activities, and a remarkable 1 km indoor ski slope. With over 12,000 parking spaces, Meydan One Mall is expected to attract nearly six million visitors annually, adding to the convenience and appeal of living in Karl Lagerfeld Villas Dubai.

Mosques Near Karl Lagerfeld

Several mosques are located within the sub-communities of MBR City, providing convenient places of worship for residents. Among them are Masjid Al Joud, Al Shakireen Masjid, and Syeda Khadija Mosque, catering to the spiritual needs of the community. Additionally, Dubai Hills Mosque, situated near Al Marabea Street (D65), offers another accessible option for those residing in the area.

Location & Nearby Areas

Karl Lagerfeld Villas, MBR City, will offer seamless connectivity to key destinations across Dubai. Dubai Silicon Oasis will be reachable within approximately 12 minutes by car, while Dubai Design District (d3) will be just an 11-minute drive away. 

For those looking to explore waterfront living, Dubai Creek Harbour will be accessible in around 15 minutes, providing a vibrant lifestyle destination nearby.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Karl Lagerfeld Villas Dubai

data.answer:
Future residents of Karl Lagerfeld Villas Dubai will enjoy an exclusive lifestyle with world-class amenities, including a private gym, swimming pools, and entertainment decks. The serene Catwalk walkway, sky lounge, and sunken lounge will provide elegant spaces for relaxation and social gatherings.

Beaches Near Karl Lagerfeld Villas

Residents of Karl Lagerfeld MBR City will have easy access to some of Dubai’s most popular beachfront destinations, located just 12 to 15 minutes away. Sunset Beach and Jumeirah Beach will offer the perfect spots for a relaxing day by the sea or an evening stroll along the shore. For those seeking adventure, Kite Beach will provide an array of water sports activities, along with a vibrant selection of food stalls and beachfront cafés.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Residents of Karl Lagerfeld Villas Dubai will enjoy a refined lifestyle with exclusive wellness and recreation facilities. The community will feature The Catwalk walkway, offering a scenic outdoor space perfect for leisurely strolls. Fitness enthusiasts will have access to a state-of-the-art gymnasium, a private swimming pool, and an entertainment deck designed for relaxation and social gatherings. 
For those seeking ultimate indulgence, the sky lounge and bar will provide a sophisticated retreat, blending luxury with breathtaking views.

Community Events

As a prestigious gated development, Karl Lagerfeld Villas Dubai is expected to host an array of exclusive community events, fostering a refined and vibrant social atmosphere. From private gatherings at the Clubhouse Pavilion to curated lifestyle experiences that celebrate fashion, art, and culture, residents will enjoy a calendar of thoughtfully designed events. 

Attractions and Landmarks

One of the standout attractions near Karl Lagerfeld Villas, MBR City will be the Dubai Hills Golf Club, an 18-hole, par-72 championship course spanning 1.2 million square meters. Designed to offer breathtaking views of the Dubai skyline and Downtown Dubai, the club will feature a floodlit practice facility, a driving range, and a dedicated putting area. Golf enthusiasts will also have access to The Academy by Troon and two licensed restaurants, ensuring a world-class golfing experience.

Another remarkable landmark within MBR City will be the 7-kilometer man-made lagoon in District One, developed by Crystal Lagoons. This stunning water feature will provide residents with a tropical escape reminiscent of the Caribbean, offering opportunities for swimming, paddleboarding, surfing, and other water activities in a serene and picturesque setting.

As an off-plan development, Karl Lagerfeld Villas, MBR City is still in its early stages, with key amenities and infrastructure, including malls and retail spaces, yet to be completed. While the community promises an ultra-luxurious lifestyle, residents may initially need to rely on nearby districts for shopping, dining, and entertainment options.

What is Karl Lagerfeld Villas, MBR City?

Karl Lagerfeld Villas is an exclusive branded residential development by Taraf Holding, set within District 11 of MBR City, Dubai. It is the first Karl Lagerfeld-branded villa project in the Middle East, offering ultra-luxurious 5 to 7-bedroom villas.

When will Karl Lagerfeld Villas be completed?

The development is currently under construction and is expected to be completed by Q2 2027.

What makes Karl Lagerfeld Villas unique?

This development will offer a one-of-a-kind branded living experience, combining Karl Lagerfeld’s signature aesthetic with high-end architecture and luxury amenities, making it an exceptional investment and lifestyle choice.

Is Karl Lagerfeld Villas a freehold development?

Yes, Karl Lagerfeld Villas, MBR City is a freehold property, meaning both UAE nationals and foreign investors can purchase villas with full ownership rights.

Will the villas have smart home features?

While specific details are yet to be confirmed, the development is expected to incorporate modern smart home technology, enhancing convenience, security, and luxury living for residents.

What payment plans are available for purchasing a villa?

Flexible payment plans are expected to be offered by the developer, allowing buyers to secure a unit with an initial down payment and installment-based plans leading up to the completion in Q2 2027.

Will Karl Lagerfeld Villas be a good investment?

With its designer branding, prime location in MBR City, and high-end amenities, Karl Lagerfeld Villas is poised to be a prestigious investment opportunity, promising strong capital appreciation and exclusivity in Dubai’s luxury real estate market.

Nestled in the prestigious District 11, this exclusive development offers seamless connectivity to key destinations, from Downtown Dubai to Dubai Hills Golf Club. Check out the map to see how effortlessly luxury meets convenience!

data.content:
Set to redefine luxury living, Karl Lagerfeld Dubai is an upcoming branded residential development by Taraf Holding, marking the designer’s first-ever project in the Middle East. Nestled in the prestigious District 11 of MBR City, this exclusive enclave will introduce an exquisite collection of 5 to 7-bedroom villas, meticulously crafted to reflect Karl Lagerfeld’s signature style. Conveniently positioned along Al Ain – Dubai Road (E66), the development is expected to be completed by Q2 2027, offering a sophisticated address for discerning homeowners.

As a masterpiece of contemporary design, Karl Lagerfeld MBR City will feature a curated selection of premium residences, each boasting exceptional craftsmanship and refined aesthetics. The villas will be set within a gated and secure community, ensuring privacy and tranquility for residents. With interiors inspired by the visionary designer’s timeless elegance, the homes will exude a blend of modernity and sophistication, making them a coveted investment in Dubai’s evolving real estate landscape.

Beyond its architectural brilliance, the development will introduce an array of high-end communal amenities designed to enhance the residents’ lifestyle. A state-of-the-art clubhouse, a fully equipped gym, and serene swimming pools will be among the many exclusive offerings within the community. With a focus on luxury, privacy, and world-class facilities, Karl Lagerfeld Villas will redefine branded living in Dubai’s most sought-after residential destination.
